description: True price (`true_price`: lowest price it really sold at, from daily checks and archived snapshots), Stats per 30/90/180/365-day and all-time window (`stats.windows`: low/high with dates, average, price at window start, out-of-stock %, drop count, is_lowest, last_price_change), star rating and review count with history (`rating`), reviews from the store's review app (`reviews`: rating, count, star histogram, 3 recent reviews, Q&A, what reviewers mention), category rank among same-type products across stores (`category_rank`: #cheapest of N in stock, 30-day drop rank), units in stock per option (`stock`: qty, null = not limited, with its change history; `variants[].stock`), live price, every recorded price change, archived snapshots from before tracking began (`archived`, labelled "archived snapshot", not used in stats or score), 30/90-day and all-time low/average/high, deal score, checked promo code and product spec (description, tags, options, SKUs, weights, images) for one product.

variant.description: Optional option (variant) id from `variants[].id`: that size/colour's own price history
